correctness.rationale: PASS. The grouping identity H(n)=(1/n)prod_{q^e||n}(q^(2e+1)+1)/(q+1) specializes to prod F(q)/(pqr). Since F(q)=q^2-q+1 ≡1 mod q, integrality gives each vertex an incoming edge; the minimal-counterexample descent on mutual divisibility of F excludes two-cycles, forcing a 3-cycle. Every smaller qualifying product <=N has smallest p^3<=N, first q|F(p), p*q*(p+1)<=N and last r|F(q), p<r<=N/(pq), F(r)≡0 mod p. Independent SymPy complete exact-factor scan yielded 7339 possible smallest primes, 1948 first edges, maximum intermediate q 19771363 and precisely one closing product N. Divisibility and exact H(N) verified. This is exhaustive by the cutoff argument, not unbounded experiment.
